newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stockpile sells 215 tonnes of tin.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stockpile sells 215 tonnes of tin.

text.p: The U.S. Defense National Stockpile Center said it sold 215 tonnes of Longhorn tin for an average price of $2.648 per pound.

The four companies who were awarded metal were Tin International, 5 tonnes at a unit price of $2.70 per lb, Non Ferrous Metals, 5 tonnes at $2.67 per lb, Rotometals, 5 tonnes at $2.65 per lb, and RMT, 200 tonnes in four lots at prices ranging from $2.645 to $2.65 per lb.
The total value of the 215 tonnes was $1,255,563.
Bids on the next tin offer are due on February 5.
